geometry_policy: Every original triangle once; no topology/UV/corner-normal/material/texture edits. Face ownership is explicitly inferred, not original bone weights.
limitations: Clothed joint centers are inferred from visible garment/limb surfaces, not captured bones.
Hair and coat rigid ownership may visibly separate at joints; render and engine motion QA are required.
All outputs stay local candidates; no playable registry/Studio/API calls.
